correctness.rationale: For each fixed set J of r singleton labels, the exact probability is B_{n-r}/B_n. Multivariate factorial moments for disjoint endpoint windows are the falling window-size products times this Bell ratio and converge to independent Poisson moments under a_n~W(n)/n; opposite windows disjoint because n*a_n grows. The resulting local point-process limit gives independent exponential first/last gaps. Expected-gap convergence is separately justified using fourth factorial moments of total singleton count, conditional hypergeometric uniformly random locations, and uniform integrability. Finite indicator covariance is strictly positive by Bell/Dobinski log-convexity. Independently enumerated every set partition n=2..7 and checked prescribed one-/two-singleton Bell ratios.
